title: Slash hero
description: A window-tall black hero with a full-bleed lit render behind it: a small rating chip, a 64px serif headline whose last word rolls up to the next on a loop, a short grey line, and an email box with a white button inside; along the bottom a caption over an endlessly scrolling, edge-faded row of customer wordmarks. On phones the render sits under the form.
notes: 100svh tall on desktop (content-sized on phones); leaves 100px at the top for the fixed slash-header
two to five rolling words; CSS only, the first word stays under reduced motion
the render slot is cropped like object-fit: cover; a soft light stands in when empty
